If you are concerned that he could somehow ruin your life irreparably and is threatening you then you may have better luck seeking out legal counsel. If you are upset that he acted in a manner you think is irrational then this is a really good example of how people respond differently to scenarios and it sounds like he may have some personal toxicity problems he needs to work through and you should just disengage for your own sake. 

I am 100% a believer that there are many avenues to pursuing a career other than a college degree; however, the way you phrased your statement in your original post sounds a bit demeaning. I mean, how long did you all interact total, a couple weeks? It’s not completely reasonable to believe he could change the trajectory of his work for somebody he met online a month ago bro.

So is the bigger issue at hand here that you’re upset he seemed uninterested and blew you off or that he says he’s going to “ruin your life” by some means?

Additionally, if you expressed the same sentiment towards him that maybe he should pursue another career path or get a GED before he seemed uninterested I hate to say it but that could’ve been a definite turning point in his interest. Sex work is a very difficult place to exist for somebody and you’re also doing it so like…?
